4438.title: Relative links lack local routing in embedded chat
4438.rootCauseOneLine: Absent navigation context leaves embedded chat without a local-file callback; renderer retains relative href.
4438.proposedFix: Derive local-file navigation from the thread environment when parent navigation is absent.
4438.caveats: Two clean component tests plus actual renderer browser clicks. Full plugin page/live workspace preview and broader #4466 untested.
